actions.name: Use
actions.effect: object touched Effect magical, heatless flame

description.summary: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch.
description.value: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn’t use oxygen. A greater torchlight can be covered and hidden but not smothered or quenched. Light spells counter and dispel darkness spells of an equal or lower level.
